items.title: Very strong El Niño favors wetter South and warmer North in NOAA’s 2026–27 winter outlook, U.S.
items.summary: A strengthening El Niño is shifting the odds toward wetter-than-average conditions across the southern United States and East Coast during winter 2026–27, according to NOAA. The Climate Prediction Center (CPC) reported that the latest weekly Niño-3.4 sea-surface temperature anomaly had reached +2.4°C (+4.3°F), while warmer-than-average conditions are favored across much of the northern United States. items.title: Japan’s JMA apologizes after issuing false M9.9 earthquake warning across large parts of Japan
items.summary: The Japan Meteorological Agency (JMA) issued an erroneous M9.9 earthquake early warning across large parts of Japan on October 16, 2026, following an actual M6.9 earthquake near Russia's Kamchatka Peninsula. items.title: Strong M6.9 earthquake hits Kamchatka Peninsula, Russia
